space.description: model (the default; stations are model feet)

alignment.description: the alignment the stations are on (default the only one)

items.description: BEGIN | END | PI-n | PC-n | PT-n | MC-n | T-n | EQ-n | '86+50.00' | 8650, optionally '@offset' (ft, right +, e.g. 'PC-2@18', '86+50@25L'); or {ref|station, offset, region}. BC-n and EC-n, as a Caltrans plan letters them, are PC-n and PT-n

follow.description: between two points at the same offset, follow the alignment (arcs on its curves, exactly as draw_offset) instead of a straight chord (default true); where the offset changes the run is a straight taper

polyline.description: draw one polyline (curves as arc segments) instead of lines and arcs

close.description: close back to the first point

layer.description: layer name; defaults to the current layer
